_note: Active abilities. cost is essence; reflux_per_cost is how much reflux each essence point leaves behind, on that ability's affinity. Progress (0-100 per stage) advances by essence spent through the ability times a use multiplier (balance.abilities); a full stage waits for a bound construct of the matching tier (design/01 LAW 4). Which abilities a character starts with comes from the kits in affinities.json. kinds: projectile | melee_burst | dash | beam | targeted_strike | blink (design/05 Appendix A). A skill touches an enemy through a hit payload - on_hit / on_pass / on_arrive - with any of: damage or damage_mult (taken from the skill when absent), status, shove (metres), marks (Live), interrupts. 'summary' is the one-line rule shown to the player. Water and lightning are built to design/05 step 1 and fire to step 3 (a dash may carry 'trail', a strip of ground that applies a payload every tick_s, and 'stops_at_bodies'; a targeted_strike may 'consume_status' for per_stack_damage and a 'burst'); earth and wind still use the plain three behaviours. Abilities do NOT hurt their caster (Brent 2026-10-11). Every name and verse is original to this project - the two water skills that carried the books' own names were renamed on 2026-10-12 (ids kept for saves). Numbers are first guesses [MODEL].

water_bolt.name: Water Bolt
water_bolt.summary: First enemy hit is Soaked and knocked back a step.

tsunami_strike.name: Breaker
tsunami_strike.summary: A wide blow that throws everyone it hits 4 m away from you. Stand so the wall is behind them.

hydraulic_flex.name: Sluice Step
hydraulic_flex.summary: A short dash straight through enemies, Soaking each one you pass.

cinder_spit.name: Cinder Spit
cinder_spit.verse: A coal from the mouth. It was never going to stay in.
cinder_spit.summary: A quick, cheap bolt that sets its target Alight. Weak cold; it is how you get hot.

kiln_fist.name: Kiln Fist
kiln_fist.verse: Fire the hand like clay. Then find out what it breaks.
kiln_fist.summary: One enemy in reach: a heavy blow, 2 Alight, interrupts. If it was already burning, every stack is spent for +40 and the blow bursts, lighting those beside it.

flashover.name: Flashover
flashover.verse: The room does not burn slowly. Neither do you.
flashover.summary: A short dash that leaves a line of flame for 3 s: anything standing in it catches. It does not carry you through enemies.

slingstone.name: Slingstone
slingstone.verse: A stone has all the time there is. Lend it yours.

landslide_blow.name: Landslide Blow
landslide_blow.verse: The hill does not swing. It simply stops holding on.

bedrock_shove.name: Bedrock Shove
bedrock_shove.verse: Put your shoulder where the mountain keeps its own.

cutting_gust.name: Cutting Gust
cutting_gust.verse: Air has an edge. Most people never find it.

downdraft.name: Downdraft
downdraft.verse: Bring the sky down the length of your arm.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.verse: Something behind you agrees you should leave.

arc_lash.name: Arc Lash
arc_lash.verse: It was there and now it is here.
arc_lash.summary: Instant, short, cannot miss what it points at. Leaves 1 Live mark. Walls stop it.

thunderclap_palm.name: Thunderclap Palm
thunderclap_palm.verse: The sound arrives after the damage, to apologise.
thunderclap_palm.summary: One enemy, in reach: a heavy blow, 2 Live marks, and it stops whatever they were doing.

stepped_leader.name: Stepped Leader
stepped_leader.verse: Find the path first. Then take all of it at once.
stepped_leader.summary: You are simply there, up to 6 m away. 1 Live mark on everything beside where you land.
